title: Content mod item (data/<id>/horizon/item/<name>.json)
description: An item of a content mod: a vanilla template item's components under <id>:<name>, with these changed. Reference: docs/mods.md in Horizon.

components.description: A data component patch: minecraft:<type> sets one (minecraft:max_damage), !minecraft:<type> with {} removes it. A type no vanilla item has is refused.

crafting_remainder.description: What it leaves in the crafting grid when used in a recipe (minecraft:bucket).
